failure_modes: Pair-kernel and landmark contrasts are diagnostic only; the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term, so an edit targeting them would not change the operative reward.
Survival and increment credit are recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable.
Increment contrasts disagree in sign with endpoint contrasts, and turnover edge rates and residuals have opposite signs, so edit direction is not established.
Continuous contrast curves have many sign changes and strong sign conflicts, and polynomial fits are rejected, so time-conditioned teacher blends are unsupported.
Any temperature proposal would be an interface violation; temperatures are immutable.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest and most reproducible signed contrasts are for the short-range pair kernels (endpoint_effects:9-11 positive with positive batch fraction 1.0; endpoint_effects:13 negative with fraction 0.0; branch_adjusted:163,164,240,241 positive and branch_adjusted:167,244 negative). However, the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions), so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) changes that coordinate observable. The landmark soft-min/occupancy contrasts (endpoint_effects:14,32,68) and survival enrichment (survival_effects:0,70,100) are recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity, and decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available; clocks). Increment contrasts disagree in sign with endpoint contrasts (increment_effects:14,3,4,10), and turnover edge rates and residuals have opposite signs (turnover:1,2), so the direction of any coordinate edit is not defensibly established. The continuous contrast functions are observed-node interpolations with many sign changes and strong sign conflicts (continuous:1,2,3,7,17,19,21), and the curve-fidelity audit rejects polynomial fits, so a time-conditioned teacher blend or temporal region edit is not supported by validated curves. Joint diagnostics are descriptive within-selector associations (joint_diagnostics:1,2,11,14,15) and the information audit states it is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed. Because no registered bounded edit has a defensible expected advantage on the primary affinity objective, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a validated, sign-consistent endpoint contrast for a coordinate observable that the executing pointcloud scalar actually contains, with batch agreement at or above the observed range.
